summary: The filing is an 8-K by Bridgecrest Auto Funding LLC as depositor for a new auto-loan securitization trust (Bridgecrest Lending Auto Securitization Trust 2026-2). It reports the issuance of multiple classes of asset-backed notes (Class A-1 through D) under an existing shelf registration and files legality and tax opinions from Mayer Brown LLP and Morris James LLP as an undertaking. No special-situation event or strategic corporate action is disclosed—this is a routine ABS takedown. There are no deal terms, premiums, or board recommendations. The filing is a standard shelf takedown and not a special situation.
